_comment: Curated champion-specific ability notes, keyed by champion then flag. Shown as the per-pick 'detail' under a fired rule so each champion's reasoning is its own kit, not a generic archetype line. Phase-1 champs already supply these via champion_judgment.json 'why'; this file covers the 20 seed champs (and can override anything). Keys must be exact flag names the rules key on (anti_tank, hard_engage, frontline, anti_ad, point_click_cc, cc_immunity, pick_potential, disengage, team_heal_shield, projectile_block, burst, scaling_late, ...).

Malphite.hard_engage: R Unstoppable Force — an unstoppable charge that knocks up the whole enemy team
Malphite.frontline: armor stacking + passive shield make him an immovable frontline
Malphite.anti_ad: passive shield + E attack-speed shred + armor scaling hard-counter AD

Vayne.anti_tank: W Silver Bolts — every 3rd hit deals % max-HP true damage, melting tanks

Leona.hard_engage: E Zenith Blade into R Solar Flare locks a target down from range

Thresh.pick_potential: Q Death Sentence hooks a target from screens away
Thresh.disengage: W lantern peels an ally out + E Flay knocks divers back

Lux.burst: Q root sets up a full Q-E-R combo that deletes squishies

Zed.burst: shadow combo + R Death Mark one-shots a marked carry

Malzahar.point_click_cc: R Nether Grasp is a point-and-click suppress — undodgeable

Olaf.cc_immunity: R Ragnarok makes him fully CC-immune for the duration
Olaf.anti_tank: E Reckless Swing deals true damage that ignores armor

Cho'Gath.anti_tank: E Vorpal Spikes % max-HP + R Feast true-damage execute punish tanks
Cho'Gath.frontline: R stacks permanent max health into a giant frontline

Kassadin.scaling_late: Riftwalk hyperscaler — weak early, oppressive once items online

Amumu.hard_engage: R Curse of the Sad Mummy is a long, AoE multi-target stun engage
Amumu.frontline: tanky aura bruiser that sits on the enemy backline

Janna.disengage: Q knockup + R Monsoon blow the enemy off your carries
Janna.team_heal_shield: E Eye of the Storm shields an ally + R heals the team

Soraka.team_heal_shield: W Astral Infusion + R Wish keep the whole team topped up

Fizz.burst: E Playful/Trickster dodges then R Chum the Waters bursts a target
Fizz.pick_potential: R shark is a long-range lockdown to start a pick

Yasuo.projectile_block: W Wind Wall destroys all enemy projectiles in a wide arc

Ezreal.blink: Arcane Shift (E) is a blink to dodge skillshots, escape dives, and reposition in fights
Ezreal.high_mobility: low-cooldown E blink (reset-adjacent off Q poke) keeps him extremely safe and elusive
